game_concept: A logic puzzle set in Snowy Hold – Chimney Roofs, snowy chimney rooftops: the sled courier must handle blizzard sprites while practicing functions. Core idea – Library Builder: Combine small functions into a reusable library the sled courier calls throughout the level.
theme: Snowy Hold – Chimney Roofs: snowy chimney rooftops
core_gameplay_loop: In Chimney Roofs, repeat each round: Combine small functions into a reusable library the sled courier calls throughout the level. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the library value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Reach the larder door using at most 19 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
win_condition: The larder door reached with actions_used <= 19.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 19 before the larder door is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 10 (extended tier): Library Builder
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Library Builder' (Week 6 slot 14), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Chimney Roofs'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Snowy Hold

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how library changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against blizzard sprites in Chimney Roofs.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The larder door reached with actions_used <= 19.
